en: A sepia-toned photograph of a large formal gathering in a courtyard surrounded by a two‑story arcade with arches and balconies. Dozens of well‑dressed men and women in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing fill the courtyard, many wearing hats and light-colored dresses or suits. Potted plants and small trees line the edges of the space. On the upper floors, additional people watch from windows and balconies. At the far end of the courtyard is a decorative arch or stage with greenery and a central emblem above it, giving the impression of a ceremonial or festive event in a grand civic or hotel building. The overall format and border suggest it is an early photographic postcard.
